lines.zh: 我沿石英台阶走上讲台，袍角扫过灰。
lines.en: I climb the quartz steps to the pulpit, robe sweeping dust.

lines.zh: 铃声还在前头，我得赶在它停下之前。
lines.en: The bell still rings ahead; I must arrive before it fades.

lines.zh: 这一排回廊，我已走过三百次。
lines.en: I have walked this colonnade three hundred times.

lines.zh: 脚步要慢，圣所听得见急躁。
lines.en: Step slowly; the Sanctum hears impatience.

lines.zh: 我要去东廊宣读今日的训诫。
lines.en: I go to the east hall to read today's lesson.

lines.zh: 教众跪在两侧，我从中间过去。
lines.en: The faithful kneel on both sides as I pass between.

lines.zh: 香灰在靴底积了薄薄一层。
lines.en: A thin layer of incense ash gathers under my boots.

lines.zh: 谁把烛台挪了位置，我得摆正。
lines.en: Someone moved the candlestick; I shall set it right.

lines.zh: 我数着石柱，第七根后面该转弯。
lines.en: I count the pillars; past the seventh, I turn.

lines.zh: 高处风冷，正合宣读判决。
lines.en: The wind is cold up here, fitting for reading verdicts.

lines.zh: 钟一响，全体起身，我走在最前。
lines.en: At the bell, all rise, and I lead the way.

lines.zh: 我的影子先一步爬上了祭坛。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the altar before I do.

lines.zh: 我抚平袖口的每一道褶。
lines.en: I smooth every fold along my sleeve.

lines.zh: 圣所的火不该灭，我盯着它。
lines.en: The Sanctum's flame must not die; I watch it.

lines.zh: 这段话我已背了太久，忘了出处。
lines.en: I have repeated this passage so long I forget its origin.

lines.zh: 有人会来。我知道他们总会来。
lines.en: Someone will come. They always come.

lines.zh: 我把手按在胸口，那里什么也没跳。
lines.en: I press my chest; nothing there is beating.

lines.zh: 讲台边缘被我摸得发亮。
lines.en: The pulpit's rim is worn bright by my hands.

lines.zh: 今天的日光太直，照不进回廊。
lines.en: Today's light falls too straight to reach the colonnade.

lines.zh: 我听见远处门轴转动的声音。
lines.en: I hear a door hinge turning far off.

lines.zh: 祈祷词念到一半，我停住了。
lines.en: Halfway through the prayer, I fall silent.

lines.zh: 台下空着，我仍把话说完了。
lines.en: The seats are empty; still I finish the speech.

lines.zh: 你身上没有灰，也不是我们的人。
lines.en: You carry no ash, and you are not one of us.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你配不配站着。
lines.en: Lift your head; let me judge if you may stand.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着外面的沙。
lines.en: There is outside sand on your boots.

lines.zh: 很少有访客能走到这一层。
lines.en: Few visitors reach this tier at all.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见了不信任。
lines.en: I see disbelief in your eyes.

lines.zh: 别四处看，圣所的墙都有耳朵。
lines.en: Do not look around; these walls have ears.

lines.zh: 你站在下首，这已经算优待。
lines.en: You stand below the dais; consider that a kindness.

lines.zh: 你的手放错了地方，收回去。
lines.en: Your hand rests where it should not; withdraw it.

lines.zh: 我在讲道，你却在数出口。
lines.en: I am preaching, and you are counting the exits.

lines.zh: 你会听见的，只要你留下。
lines.en: You will hear the truth, if you stay.

lines.zh: 你竟敢碰传道人的袍子。
lines.en: You dare lay hands on an apostle's robe.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下石屑作响。
lines.en: I stagger back half a step, grit crunching underfoot.

lines.zh: 这点伤，讲道时提一句就够。
lines.en: This wound merits one line in the sermon.

lines.zh: 香灰混着血，颜色不好看。
lines.en: Ash mixed with blood makes an unseemly color.

lines.zh: 我会让你为这一下多跪一夜。
lines.en: For that blow, you will kneel an extra night.

lines.zh: 我的袖子破了，这比伤口更糟。
lines.en: My sleeve is torn; that is worse than the wound.

lines.zh: 教众看见了吗，都看见了吧。
lines.en: Did the faithful see that? They all saw, surely.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把训诫念完。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and finish the lesson.

lines.zh: 痛感让我想起自己还有身体。
lines.en: The pain reminds me I still have a body.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就改口叫你名字。
lines.en: One more hit, and I will use your name aloud.

lines.zh: 那枚绿宝石该放进祭盘，不是口袋。
lines.en: That emerald belongs in the offering dish, not your pocket.

lines.zh: 若你献上它，我可以少说两句。
lines.en: Offer it up, and I may shorten my sermon.

lines.zh: 举高一点，让我看清成色。
lines.en: Hold it higher; let me judge its worth.

lines.zh: 圣所收下一切，也从不归还。
lines.en: The Sanctum accepts all things and returns none.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在发光，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That thing in your hand glows, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 把它放下，退三步，再说话。
lines.en: Set it down, step back three paces, then speak.

lines.zh: 我可以为这枚宝石破例一次。
lines.en: For this gem, I might make an exception.

lines.zh: 献礼的人，我会记住名字。
lines.en: I remember the names of those who bring gifts.

lines.zh: 别握那么紧，献给圣所不疼。
lines.en: Do not grip it so; giving to the Sanctum does not hurt.

lines.zh: 这件旧物，是从哪座墓里拿的？
lines.en: This old relic, from which tomb did you take it?

lines.zh: 退后，你的肩撞到了我的袍。
lines.en: Back away; your shoulder brushed my robe.

lines.zh: 这条回廊不供人并排走。
lines.en: This colonnade is not for walking side by side.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的影子，让开。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; move aside.

lines.zh: 上一次撞我的人跪了整夜。
lines.en: The last one who bumped me knelt all night.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，灰会沾上你。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; the ash will cling to you.

lines.zh: 我有台阶要走，你挡在中间。
lines.en: I have steps to climb, and you block the middle.

lines.zh: 让路，教众都懂得让路。
lines.en: Make way; even the faithful know to make way.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted that collision.

lines.zh: 你身上有汗味，圣所不容。
lines.en: You smell of sweat; the Sanctum permits none.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意，你就该退开。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, you should withdraw.

lines.zh: 我已许给圣所，不谈这些。
lines.en: I am pledged to the Sanctum; we do not speak of that.

lines.zh: 传道人不结伴，只带教众。
lines.en: An apostle takes no partner, only followers.

lines.zh: 我的誓言写在石头上，擦不掉。
lines.en: My vow is cut into stone and cannot be erased.

lines.zh: 这种念头，去问下面的教众。
lines.en: Take that notion to the cultists below.

lines.zh: 讲台只站一个人，从来如此。
lines.en: The pulpit holds one speaker, always has.

lines.zh: 别在我面前提成双的事。
lines.en: Do not mention pairing in my presence.

lines.zh: 圣所给我的位置，不需要第二把椅子。
lines.en: The seat the Sanctum gave me needs no second chair.

lines.zh: 我守的是训诫，不是血脉。
lines.en: I keep the doctrine, not a bloodline.

lines.zh: 孤独是职位的一部分，我认了。
lines.en: Solitude is part of the office; I accept it.

lines.zh: 你要找伴，去市场那边。
lines.en: If you seek company, try the market quarter.

lines.zh: 我捡起滚落的烛芯，吹灭它。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen wick and blow it out.

lines.zh: 这份供品记在东廊的账上。
lines.en: This offering goes on the east hall's ledger.

lines.zh: 地上有枚铜片，属于祭器。
lines.en: A copper fragment on the floor belongs to the altar set.

lines.zh: 我拾起断掉的念珠，收进袖中。
lines.en: I gather the broken beads and tuck them in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 谁把训诫卷轴扔在这里？
lines.en: Who left the doctrine scroll lying here?

lines.zh: 这块布是旗帜的一角，我认得。
lines.en: This cloth is a corner of our banner; I know it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，教众都不敢出声。
lines.en: When I bend to pick it up, the faithful hold their breath.

lines.zh: 石头缝里卡着一枚指环。
lines.en: A ring is wedged in a crack between stones.

lines.zh: 拾起它，就等于替人赎了罪。
lines.en: Picking this up absolves someone of a sin.

lines.zh: 我把它举高，让所有人看见。
lines.en: I lift it high so everyone can see.

lines.zh: 闯入者，你的名字要写进名册了。
lines.en: Intruder, your name goes into the register now.

lines.zh: 我看见你踏过了界线，回头吧。
lines.en: I saw you cross the line; turn back.

lines.zh: 圣所已经注意到你了。
lines.en: The Sanctum has taken notice of you.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑的人会被记住更久。
lines.en: Do not run; runners are remembered longer.

lines.zh: 你带着外面的味道，很重。
lines.en: You carry the outside on you, strongly.

lines.zh: 全体退下，这个人由我处置。
lines.en: All of you stand back; this one is mine.

lines.zh: 我举起手，钟就会响。
lines.en: If I raise my hand, the bell will ring.

lines.zh: 你选了最坏的一天进来。
lines.en: You chose the worst day to come in.

lines.zh: 训诫第七条：擅入者不留。
lines.en: Doctrine, seventh line: trespassers do not remain.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到了火把的烟。
lines.en: I smell torch smoke on you.

lines.zh: 站住，你的影子已经出卖你。
lines.en: Stand still; your shadow has already betrayed you.

lines.zh: 圣所的门在你身后合上了。
lines.en: The Sanctum's door has closed behind you.

lines.zh: 我给你一次跪下的机会。
lines.en: I offer you one chance to kneel.

lines.zh: 让开回廊，我要开始宣判。
lines.en: Clear the colonnade; I am beginning the sentence.

lines.zh: 名册翻到空白的一页，写你。
lines.en: The roster falls open to a blank page: you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越浅，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing shallows; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走下台阶，不着急。
lines.en: I come down the steps slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，那里没有门。
lines.en: You back into the corner; there is no door there.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，灰就会盖住你。
lines.en: One more step, and the ash will cover you.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就该跪了。
lines.en: I will count to three, and you should kneel.

lines.zh: 手里那根火把，举得再高也没用。
lines.en: Raise that torch higher; it will not help.

lines.zh: 你身后是我的人，你不知道吧。
lines.en: My people are behind you; you did not know.

lines.zh: 别指望门，门只听我的话。
lines.en: Do not count on the door; it obeys me.

lines.zh: 我讲道时，从不背对听众。
lines.en: When I preach, I never turn my back on the audience.

lines.zh: 你已经在祭坛的影子里了。
lines.en: You are already inside the altar's shadow.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，我喜欢看人犹豫。
lines.en: Take your time; I enjoy watching hesitation.

lines.zh: 这一层只有你和我的脚步声。
lines.en: On this tier, only your steps and mine.

lines.zh: 别摸武器，那会拖长这件事。
lines.en: Do not reach for a weapon; it will only lengthen this.

lines.zh: 我把袖子挽起来，你自己看着办。
lines.en: I roll up my sleeve; do as you see fit.

lines.zh: 你脚下的灰，是我铺的。
lines.en: The ash under your feet is mine to lay.

lines.zh: 钟响第三下，就动手。
lines.en: On the third bell, we begin.

lines.zh: 我抬手，回廊的灯依次灭。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the corridor lamps die in order.

lines.zh: 别看我身后，那里没有人。
lines.en: Do not look behind me; no one is there.

lines.zh: 我用手背打你，因为你不配用刀。
lines.en: I strike with the back of my hand; you deserve no blade.

lines.zh: 这一下是替圣所讨的。
lines.en: This blow is collected on the Sanctum's behalf.

lines.zh: 你倒地时，我还在念训诫。
lines.en: As you fall, I am still reciting the lesson.

lines.zh: 灰从我的袖口洒到你脸上。
lines.en: Ash spills from my sleeve onto your face.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，把你压向石阶。
lines.en: I pin your shoulder down against the stone steps.

lines.zh: 别挣扎，越挣扎名册记得越细。
lines.en: Stop struggling; the register records struggle in detail.

lines.zh: 我的指节敲在石柱上，回音很响。
lines.en: My knuckles crack against the pillar, echoing loudly.

lines.zh: 你流血了，圣所的地不喜欢这个。
lines.en: You bleed; the Sanctum's floor dislikes that.

lines.zh: 我抬手，整条回廊都安静了。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and the whole colonnade quiets.

lines.zh: 这一掌是给不肯跪的人留的。
lines.en: This palm is reserved for those who will not kneel.

lines.zh: 你听见钟声了吗，那是给你的。
lines.en: Do you hear the bell? It rings for you.

lines.zh: 我把你按在讲台边上，好好听。
lines.en: I hold you at the pulpit's edge; now listen well.

lines.zh: 教众在看着，我不能打得难看。
lines.en: The faithful are watching; I must not fight ugly.

lines.zh: 你倒下之后，会有人来收。
lines.en: After you fall, someone will come to collect you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口，往上提。
lines.en: I seize your collar and lift.

lines.zh: 灰落进你眼里，你眨得很慢。
lines.en: Ash gets in your eyes; you blink slowly.

lines.zh: 钟声未落，我已站在讲台上。
lines.en: The bell still sounds, and I am already at the pulpit.

lines.zh: 这一层的光，是为我留的。
lines.en: This tier's light was kept for me.

lines.zh: 我从内殿走出来，袍上带着香。
lines.en: I step from the inner sanctum, robes smelling of incense.

lines.zh: 教众低头，说明有人到了。
lines.en: The faithful bow; that means someone has arrived.

lines.zh: 又是新的一天，又一批听道的人。
lines.en: Another day, another crowd to hear the word.

lines.zh: 我整整袖口，才开口说话。
lines.en: I straighten my cuffs before I speak a word.

lines.zh: 圣所今天很吵，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The Sanctum is loud today; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我推开内殿的门，灰落了一肩。
lines.en: I push open the inner door; ash settles on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 谁在下面走动，声音这么急。
lines.en: Someone moves below, and their steps are hurried.

lines.zh: 我站到光里，让所有人看见。
lines.en: I stand in the light so all may see me.

lines.zh: 训诫还没念完，你们来得正好。
lines.en: The lesson is unfinished; you arrived at the right time.

lines.zh: 这是我的位置，别站上去。
lines.en: This is my place; do not stand on it.

lines.zh: 火燎到袍角，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame catches my hem; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滑下去，很难看。
lines.en: I slide down the steps; it is unbecoming.

lines.zh: 内殿的水池比我想的深。
lines.en: The inner pool is deeper than I judged.

lines.zh: 石柱断了，我的耳朵在响。
lines.en: The pillar breaks, and my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肩头，钉在讲台上。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my shoulder and sticks in the pulpit.

lines.zh: 有东西钻进了我的祷词里。
lines.en: Something has wormed its way into my prayer.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃，供品都凉了。
lines.en: I forgot to eat; the offerings have gone cold.

lines.zh: 雷落在石英上，白得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the quartz, blindingly white.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，连回音也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing below, not even an echo.
